decisions.reason: Because A is close to the core offer, has its own page, and shows at least some positive agency-oriented feedback in a growing market, management would likely see performance as near aspiration and retain it while monitoring it.
Because B is highlighted on the home page and described as a flagship tied to the firm's strategic direction, management is very unlikely to drop it unless results clearly disappoint.

Because C is a close extension of the established hosting business and the firm appears to have enough slack from industry growth and ongoing R&D to support recent launches, management would likely keep it unless early demand falls well short of expectations.
